rows.Publishable body copy:
Naxos rewards travellers who combine the walkable lanes of Chora, the long sandy west coast and the mountain villages of the interior. Use this guide to choose a base, decide how many days you need and separate the places reachable by bus from the routes that are easier with a car.

## Naxos in one minute
Largest island in the Cyclades, with Chora and Portara in the west, a long beach corridor to the south-west and a mountainous interior around Chalki, Filoti and Apeiranthos.

## How many days
Three days cover Chora, one beach day and one inland loop; four to five days allow slower beaches, Mount Zas or a north-coast drive.

## Where to stay
Choose Chora for ferries and evenings, Agios Prokopios or Agia Anna for easy beach access, Plaka for a quieter coast, or a village for an inland stay.

## Getting around
Bus routes work for Chora and popular west-coast beaches. A car adds flexibility for villages, archaeological sites, early starts and multi-stop days.

## Best driving routes
Link to a village loop, south-west beach day, north-coast drive and a short arrival-day route with realistic stops.

## Plan with verified details
Check ferry, flight, road and opening information close to travel; every time-sensitive claim needs a checked date and source.
